'''John Patelle''' won the Thursday-night heat of the [[DecipherCon 1999 Players Choice]] Players' Choice Sealed Deck on 11 November 1999, out of 36 players, according to [[Ryan Patterson]], who ran it.<ref name="cec-dc1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.1], Ryan Patterson, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030053/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
